text:
incident-bot: Pager: severity=P1 · container crashloop on runtime-pool-prod-3 · 8 hosts affected · auto-escalate in 5m · link: https://incidents.redwood.internal/3290011111

oncall-mike: saw the pager, jumping in. which service?

sre-ana: runtime docker image: redwood/runtime:2026-03-15-quant. Crash loopbacks on vLLM worker containers after ~20s. Logs show SIGBUS then restart.

eng-runtime-lee: SIGBUS not SIGSEGV. could be misaligned memory from custom quant kernel (we shipped the fused quant patch yesterday).

eng-ml-ravi: confirming: model variant is rdl-7b-quant-fused. rolled to 30% yesterday for perf testing (auto-canary).

oncall-mike: customers impacted? any frontline alerts?

cust-success-julia: support queue: 3 customers reporting 503s (chat endpoints) starting ~08:12 UTC. SLA pages are coming in. prioritizing enterprise customers.

infra-bot: Host health snapshot: hosts runtime-pool-prod-3-{a..h} show repeated kubelet restarts on container runtime, OOM not present. Node swap events: 3 nodes auto-drained by autoscaler.

eng-runtime-lee: grabbing logs from one container:
```
[2026-03-15T08:14:02Z] runtime::kv_cache::load_prefetch() at fused_quant.c:421
[2026-03-15T08:14:02Z] GPU 0: launching quant kernel
[2026-03-15T08:14:02Z] kernel returned error: CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS
[2026-03-15T08:14:02Z] terminating with signal SIGBUS (code=1, fault_addr=0x7f8a3c000)
```

eng-ml-ravi: CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS often means out-of-bounds in a kernel or a bad pointer. matches fused quant changes.

sre-ana: immediate mitigation? can we revert the canary or fallback to non-fused variant?

eng-runtime-lee: we have runtime switch that can route to fallback model variant (rdl-7b-quant-vanilla). I'll disable fused variant routing from the service config now.

oncall-mike: do we need to scale down pool to avoid repeated node flaps while we roll?

eng-runtime-lee: yes please. plan: 1) update routing to 0% fused variant 2) scale pool to reduce churn 3) cordon worst nodes and restart kubelet if needed. Doing step 1 now.

eng-runtime-lee: (config patch)
```
PATCH /service/runtime/variants
- fused: 30%
+ fused: 0%
```

incident-bot: Config change applied by eng-runtime-lee at 08:18:12 UTC. Traffic now routed away from fused variant.

infra-bot: Scaling runtime-pool-prod-3 from 24 -> 8 replicas (safe low) to limit node churn. Started at 08:18:35 UTC.

cust-success-julia: support queue update: new requests slowing after 08:22 UTC, two customers report degraded but recovered. marking high-touch customers notified.

oncall-mike: any root cause evidence we should capture? stack dumps? gdb backtrace?

eng-runtime-lee: captured a user-space backtrace from core:
```
#0  0x00007f8a1d4ab0 in fused_quant_kernel(void*) from /opt/runtime/lib/fused_quant.so
#1  0x00007f8a2c2f100 in launch_kernel at cuda_wrapper.c:211
#2  0x000055b1e9a1c3 in runtime::dispatch() at dispatcher.cc:462
```
Also NVTX traces show kernel spin then illegal address. attaching core and kernel parameters to the incident notebook.

eng-ml-ravi: looks like an index overflow in fused quant's packing loop. we pushed a micro-optim that removed a bounds check. bad call.

sre-ana: marking P1-> mitigation in progress. tracking timeline in incident doc: https://incidents.redwood.internal/3290011111/doc

oncall-mike: next steps for remediation/hotfix?

eng-runtime-lee: immediate hotfix options:
- revert fused quant micro-opt and roll image (fast but still needs CI)
- patch runtime to detect bad kernel return and skip fused path (safer, smaller change)
I'm for option 2 to reduce blast radius. preparing small patch.

eng-ml-ravi: I can hand off a tiny guard that checks kernel return and falls back. will push PR and request expedited review.

incident-bot: CRITICAL: new failures stopped after routing change; crash counts down 99% across pool.

cust-success-julia: customers updated. no revenue-impacting tickets opened in last 20min. continuing proactive outreach to top 5 customers.

eng-runtime-lee: PR merged and hotpatch deployed to runtime-pool-prod-3 at 08:37:40 UTC. guard unwraps illegal address -> fallback path.

infra-bot: rolling restart of remaining pods started at 08:38:05 UTC.

sre-ana: monitoring: container restarts trending to 0. watching for any residual node flaps.

oncall-mike: nice work. preparing handoff to next shift in 30m. please attach postmortem checklist items and timing in doc.

eng-ml-ravi: will add root cause: removed bounds check in fused_quant micro-opt. Remediation: re-add bounds check, additional unit test for packing loop, block canary until verified.

cust-success-julia: closing customer alerts for now, will reopen if symptoms return.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. P1 retained until services stable for 2h.

oncall-mike: tagging @next-shift for handoff. summary pinned to incident doc. (reaction :white_check_mark:)
